item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia continues airstrikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure, killing civilians in Zaporizhzhia and striking power plants in Kyiv, while Ukraine says it will pause its own refinery strikes if Russia ends its energy attacks. Ukraine hit a Russian Iskander-M ballistic missile maintenance base, and Russian forces restricted Starlink access, disrupting front-line operations. Russian authorities detained a Japanese journalist on espionage charges. President Trump announced a diesel deal with Russia framed as an energy ceasefire, which Ukraine called false after further strikes. The UCDP recorded 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

In Gaza, Israeli air strikes killed a Palestinian woman in Gaza City and a girl was rescued from a flaming apartment after an attack, while the Israeli Yellow Line advanced, leaving displaced residents with nowhere to go. The Israeli government is pursuing the reopening of settler Route 463, which would further isolate Ramallah. An article describes Israel's use of AI in Gaza as a tool of genocide. item.title: Israel and Hezbollah: the situation
item.description:
Hezbollah explosives seized in two Lebanese trucks have prompted Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation, while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel, a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack during a hike near the Lebanon border, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, leading the IDF chief to order a probe and authorities to consider restricting hikes.
